note: techniques-2026b TB-4/TB-5: traits that files passing through a platform are documented to carry. A match is recorded as a FACT ('… 표와 일치' / '… 이름 형식과 일치') — never 'came from X', never manipulation or authenticity: other software can produce the same trait. Every entry names its source; nothing here is estimated. Platforms without a citable table (KakaoTalk, LINE, Naver Band, Telegram, current Facebook/X) have none: the capture procedure to add one is in docs/FACT-LAYERS.md.

audio_codec_traces.band_rule: A band is named only when the measured edge lies in [min_hz, max_hz] (the codec / sample-rate edge) and max_hz is below 98% of the file's Nyquist frequency; a tone or a narrow sound below min_hz names nothing.
